limitations: Periodic detail bursts are replaced with sequential foreground-yielding reads; initial and actual foreground reads remain unchanged.
Cold observations and startup are not population p95; executable launch is excluded.
The preparation interval is ten seconds. Large diffs and review-rich PRs remain unverified.
Authoritative Page waits still reach 426 ms native and 394 ms web; instant navigation acceptance remains incomplete.
Cancelled speculative reads are retained in network evidence; they still consume the minute background attempt.
privacyReview: Decoded archives checked for credential patterns, body/header fields and URL queries. Shared issue data retained only as a digest.
